gloss: the whole sky, sky full of

definitions.gloss: the whole sky, the entire sky, a sky full of
definitions.explanation: The entire expanse of the sky, used almost exclusively in the expression {満天|まんてん}の{星|ほし} (a sky full of stars). Describes a sky that is completely filled with something, most typically stars.

examples.japanese: {満天|まんてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The sky full of stars is beautiful.
I saw a sky full of stars from the mountaintop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}られない→見る：00283_miru⟧{満天|まんてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感動|かんどう}した→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧。
examples.english: I was moved by the sky full of stars, something you can't see in the city.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears in the fixed expression {満天|まんてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧ (a sky full of stars) or {満天|まんてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{星空|ほしぞら}→星空：05048_hoshizora⟧ (a starry sky filled with stars). Rarely used outside this pattern.

Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{満点|まんてん}→満点：03156_manten⟧ (perfect score).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {満天|まんてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧: a sky full of stars
- {満天|まんてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{星空|ほしぞら}→星空：05048_hoshizora⟧: a starry sky (filled with stars)
- {満天|まんてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下|もと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: under a sky full of stars
